drivingQuestion: With what implements is ritual slaughter valid?
outcomeNote: A mishna stating the law; no question, objection, dispute or resolution occurs in this unit.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹחֵט בְּמַגַּל יָד, בְּצוֹר, וּבְקָנֶה – שְׁחִיטָתוֹ כְּשֵׁרָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who slaughters» an animal «with» the smooth side of «a hand sickle,» which has both a smooth and a serrated side, or «with» a sharpened «flint, or with a reed» that was cut lengthwise and sharpened, «his slaughter is valid.»

segments.he: הַכֹּל שׁוֹחֲטִין, וּלְעוֹלָם שׁוֹחֲטִין, וּבַכֹּל שׁוֹחֲטִין, חוּץ מִמַּגַּל קָצִיר, וְהַמְּגֵירָה, וְהַשִּׁינַּיִם, וְהַצִּיפּוֹרֶן, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהֵם חוֹנְקִין.
segments.en: «All slaughter [hakkol shoḥatin], and one may always slaughter, and one may slaughter with any» item that cuts, «except for» the serrated side of «the harvest sickle, a saw, the teeth» of an animal when attached to its jawbone, «and a fingernail, because» they are serrated and «they» consequently «strangle» the animal and do not cut its windpipe and gullet as required.

moves.cueHe: מתני׳ השוחט במגל יד, בצור, ובקנה
moves.summary: The mishna validates slaughter performed with the smooth side of a hand sickle, with a flint, or with a sharpened reed

moves.cueHe: הכל שוחטין, ולעולם שוחטין, ובכל שוחטין
moves.summary: The mishna states the blanket rule — everyone slaughters, always, with anything — and immediately excludes the harvest sickle, saw, teeth and fingernail
moves.about: the mishna carves four serrated implements — harvest sickle, saw, teeth, fingernail — out of its own blanket permission to slaughter with any cutting implement

moves.summary: The mishna gives the reason for the exclusions: serrated implements strangle rather than cut, their notches catching and tearing the simanim
moves.about: why the serrated implements are disqualified — they strangle rather than cut, their notches catching and tearing the windpipe and gullet
